_comment: Merged into <workspace>/.claude/settings.json. Documented in template-settings.md. Kubernetes/AWS grants live in template-settings.k8s.json (opt-in) -- this kit ships no Kubernetes anything.

hooks.command:
bash -c 'h="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/.claude/hooks/validate-commit-subject.sh"; if [ -f "$h" ]; then exec bash "$h"; fi; printf "[agent-kit] hook not installed, skipping: %s
" "$h" >&2; exit 0'

bash -c 'h="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/.claude/hooks/block-plaintext-secret-write.sh"; if [ -f "$h" ]; then exec bash "$h"; fi; printf "[agent-kit] hook not installed, skipping: %s
" "$h" >&2; exit 0'

bash -c 'h="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/.claude/hooks/block-deploy-repo-edits.sh"; if [ -f "$h" ]; then exec bash "$h"; fi; printf "[agent-kit] hook not installed, skipping: %s
" "$h" >&2; exit 0'

bash -c 'h="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/.claude/hooks/block-plaintext-secret-write.sh"; if [ -f "$h" ]; then exec bash "$h"; fi; printf "[agent-kit] hook not installed, skipping: %s
" "$h" >&2; exit 0'

bash -c 'h="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/.claude/scripts/memory-sync-reminder.sh"; if [ -f "$h" ]; then exec bash "$h"; fi; printf "[agent-kit] hook not installed, skipping: %s
" "$h" >&2; exit 0'
